_meanings:
²1 To appear, become manifest.
.²2 To be equal to, suffice for; {#ekameva tadekaM sanna vyaBavat#} <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 4. 11</ls>;
 <ls>Bhāg. 5. 1. 12</ls>.
.²3 To pervade; {#AtmanyadfcCayA prAptaM vibuBUzurupAdade#} <ls>Bhāg. 2. 5. 21</ls>.
.²4 To be able, be capable of, prevail.

.²1 To think of, reflect, contemplate.
.²2 To be aware of, know, perceive, discover, see; {#tAmindusundaramuKIM#}
 {#suciraM viBAvya#} <ls>Māl. 1. 18</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">5. 21</ls>; {#na viBAvyante laGavo vittavihInAH#}
 {#puro'pi nivasantaH#} <ls>Pt. 5. 7</ls>; <ls>U. 2. 24</ls>.
.²3 To see or observe minutely, perceive carefully; <ls>V. 4</ls>.
.²4 To decide, settle, make clear.
.²5 To manifest, show, reveal; {#yaSaH paraM jagati viBAvya vartitA#} <ls>Mb. 7. 2. 15</ls>.
.²5 To separate.
.²6 To suppose, imagine.
.²7 To convince.
.²8 To establish, prove; {#tava sucaritamaNgulIya nUnaM pratanu mameva#}
 {#viBAvyate Palena#} <ls>Ś. 6. 11</ls>.
